meta.name: amazon-product-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract structured product listings from Amazon, including titles, ASINs, prices, ratings, and specifications. Use this skill when users want to search for products on Amazon, find the best selling brand products, track price changes for items, get a list of categories with high ratings, compare different brand products on Amazon, extract Amazon product data for market research, look for products in a specific language or marketplace, analyze competitor pricing for keywords, find featured products for search terms, get technical specifications like material or color for product lists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从亚马逊提取结构化商品数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在亚马逊上批量获取商品信息用于分析或比价。
copy.tagline_en: Extract structured product data from Amazon
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch retrieve Amazon product listings for analysis or price comparison.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的关键词、品牌等条件，从亚马逊搜索并提取商品列表，包括标题、ASIN、价格、评分、规格等信息。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索亚马逊商品、比较品牌、追踪价格或做市场调研时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下亚马逊上最好的笔记本电脑
say.note: Claude 会提取商品列表并展示。

say.text: 比较戴尔和联想在亚马逊上的价格
say.note: Claude 会分别搜索并对比结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search Amazon and extract structured product listings including titles, ASINs, prices, ratings, and specifications based on your keywords, brand, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search Amazon products, compare brands, track prices, or conduct market research.

say_en.text: Search for the best laptops on Amazon.
say_en.note: Claude will extract and show product listings.

say_en.text: Compare prices of Dell and Lenovo on Amazon.
say_en.note: Claude will search and compare results.
